# Frazik

Frazik is an independent cybersecurity and AI engineering practice based in Bratislava, Slovakia.
Frazik helps Slovak companies reduce software and infrastructure risk, strengthen DevSecOps practices, and adopt private, useful AI securely.

## Services

- Cybersecurity: application and architecture reviews, threat modeling, DevSecOps practices for code, dependencies, secrets, and CI/CD, plus security controls for LLM and RAG systems.
- Private AI infrastructure: custom workstations and servers for local LLM deployments, secure setup, tuning, monitoring, maintenance, and upgrades.
- AI automation: workflow discovery, secure assistants, document and knowledge workflows, integrations, team rollout, and continuous improvement.
